scientific_question: Within one fixed Kudla exact-CDS cohort and one frozen sequence-cluster OOD split, does the incremental predictive value of mRNA structure depend on the structure source, sequence coordinate system, or coverage definition?

cohort.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of log10_expression within exact CDS; identical CDS, protein, CAI and source structure values required within a group.
cohort.cluster_definition: Reuse RK27 frozen 90% complete-linkage clusters without reclustering or outcome-dependent filtering.

structure_coordinates.local_selection_rule: Lowest label-free RMSE against source-reported rnaEnergyMinus4to37 among candidates with the stated UTR/CDS boundary; preflight selected UTR[-4:] + CDS[:38], dangles=2, 37 C.
structure_coordinates.full_cds_rule: The complete 720-nt CDS including the terminal stop, ViennaRNA dangles=2, 37 C; deliberately distinct from full mRNA.
structure_coordinates.full_mrna_rule: The complete 864-nt sequenceWithUtr = 144-nt 5'UTR + 720-nt CDS, ViennaRNA dangles=2, 37 C.
structure_coordinates.mordstein_like_rule: ViennaRNA dangles=0, 37 C on CDS[:300], plus minimum and arithmetic mean MFE over all 253 contiguous 48-nt windows whose start positions are 0 through 252 within CDS[:300].

models.histgb: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=10, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=seed+fold)

outer_evaluation.fold_assignment: Exactly reproduce RK27 make_cluster_folds: shuffle sorted cluster IDs with default_rng(seed), stable-sort by descending cluster size, assign whole clusters to least-loaded folds, resolving load ties with the same RNG.
outer_evaluation.leakage_rule: No sequence cluster may occur in both train and test. No target or model result may be used for clustering, fold assignment, arm selection or tuning.

fit_accounting.formula: 10 seeds * 5 folds * 2 models * (1 shared simple + 6 structure arms) = 700

primary_inference.bootstrap: Resample 37 cluster IDs with replacement, include all exact-CDS rows from each selected cluster, recompute paired OOF effects and take percentile 95% CI.
primary_inference.permutation: Draw one sign per cluster and swap simple and structure OOF predictions within clusters; recompute every effect directly and use two-sided absolute-effect p-values with plus-one correction.
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm across all 24 primary tests: 2 models * 6 structure arms * 2 metrics.
primary_inference.seed_stability: At least 8 of 10 seed-level effects must be positive.
primary_inference.arm_pass_rule: A structure arm passes only if all four endpoints have observed effect > 0, bootstrap CI lower bound > 0, Holm p < 0.05, and at least 8/10 positive seeds.
primary_inference.global_interpretation: ALL only if all six arms pass; DEFINITION_DEPENDENT if at least one but not all pass; NO_STRUCTURE_DEFINITION if none passes.

forbidden_claims: full external SOTA or unified time-matched comparison
